_comment: Demo overrides + imports for the race catalog. `human` is an override of default's record (note the rewritten description). `tiefling` was imported from the tiefling-pack library — once imported, the record is native to this module (no link back to the library, no future tracking). Library content that hasn't been imported (like additional races the library might add later) won't appear here automatically; the editor surfaces it in the catalog instead.

races.name: Human
races.description: Adaptable and ambitious — the demo module recasts humans as restless wanderers, quick to learn and quicker to leave.

races.name: Tiefling
races.description: Touched by infernal heritage — bears a faint heat-shimmer in dim light and is unsettled by holy ground.
